subject: Unlisted shiny app in Free plan.  Not user authentication.

messages.author: 276beb20b840713c
messages.subject: Unlisted shiny app in Free plan.  Not user authentication.
parts:
I know that the Free / Starter / Basic plans on Shinyapps.io don't allow user authentication (which is fine by me) but is there a way to keep an app "unlisted"?

i.e. People who have my app's link can (obviously) use it without authentication. But I don't want others to discover this app. e.g. via a google search or some other way. i.e. Some sort of Robots.txt file to ask google etc. not to crawl the app or the text in it. 

Is this possible? Do I have to enable this (e.g. on Google Photos one can designate a photo as "Unlisted" vs "Public") or is "unlisted" the default behavior of shinyapps.io. 

In other words are "Private" (i,e. authenticated) vs "Public" the only two flavors of a shinyapps.io app? Or is there an "unlisted" type? By default does a shiny apps name get listed in any public sense or directory?

The main goal is to conserve my Active Hours. :)

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Unlisted shiny app in Free plan.  Not user authentication.
parts:
There is no notion of unlisted that is separate from private.
That said, currently we serve a robots.txt to prevent crawling since the web crawlers don't actually interact with Shiny.
